speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any difficulty with fine motor tasks, such as buttoning a shirt or writing, and is the weakness symmetric in both hands? I also need to know if the pain worsens when you extend your neck or hold it in a specific position.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Burning pain in neck and arms, and weakness in both hands. I also have Paresthesias in hands, Absent reflexes, Decreased hand grip with fasciculations.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The presence of fasciculations, absent reflexes, and progressive weakness in a diabetic patient raises concern for motor neuron disease or severe cervical myelopathy. REQUEST TEST: Cervical_Spine_MRI
